hook.en: You studied hard but still scored lower than expected. Is it fate, or your fault — and how should a Muslim feel? Understanding qada' and qadar answers this.
hook.bm: Anda belajar bersungguh-sungguh tetapi markah tetap lebih rendah daripada jangkaan. Adakah ini takdir atau salah anda — dan bagaimanakah seorang Muslim patut berasa? Memahami qada' dan qadar menjawab persoalan ini.

bigIdeas.en: Belief in qada' and qadar is the sixth pillar of iman: everything happens by Allah's knowledge and will.
bigIdeas.bm: Beriman kepada qada' dan qadar ialah rukun iman keenam: segala-galanya berlaku dengan ilmu dan kehendak Allah.

bigIdeas.en: This belief goes together with effort (ikhtiar), prayer (doa) and trust (tawakal).
bigIdeas.bm: Kepercayaan ini seiring dengan usaha (ikhtiar), doa dan tawakal.

bigIdeas.en: Syirik, khurafat and sihir damage aqidah; belief in the Last Day guides our actions.
bigIdeas.bm: Syirik, khurafat dan sihir merosakkan akidah; beriman kepada hari akhirat membimbing tindakan kita.

detail.en: Accept the outcome with patience or gratitude
detail.bm: Menerima keputusan dengan sabar atau syukur

definition.en: Allah's decree and will from eternity (azali).
definition.bm: Ketetapan dan kehendak Allah sejak azali.

definition.en: The happening of things according to Allah's decree and measure.
definition.bm: Berlakunya sesuatu mengikut ketetapan dan ukuran Allah.

definition.en: Trusting Allah after making full effort.
definition.bm: Berserah kepada Allah selepas berusaha sepenuhnya.

definition.en: Associating partners with Allah — the greatest sin.
Superstitious beliefs not based on Islamic teaching.
definition.bm: Kepercayaan karut yang tidak berasaskan ajaran Islam.

definition.en: Doing good to be seen by others — hidden syirik (syirik khafi).
definition.bm: Melakukan kebaikan untuk dilihat orang — syirik tersembunyi (syirik khafi).

question.en: Ali failed his test even though he prayed. His friend says, "It is fate, so stop studying." Correct this view.
question.bm: Ali gagal ujian walaupun berdoa. Rakannya berkata, "Ini takdir, jadi berhenti belajar." Betulkan pandangan ini.

steps.en: Qada' and qadar do not cancel effort — Allah commands ikhtiar.
steps.bm: Qada' dan qadar tidak membatalkan usaha — Allah memerintahkan ikhtiar.

steps.en: We do not know our qadar in advance, so we must keep trying.
steps.bm: Kita tidak mengetahui takdir lebih awal, jadi kita mesti terus berusaha.

steps.en: Ali should evaluate his methods, pray, study smarter and then tawakal.
steps.bm: Ali patut menilai cara belajar, berdoa, belajar dengan lebih bijak dan kemudian bertawakal.

answer.en: Belief in qadar makes us patient when we fail and humble when we succeed — not lazy.
answer.bm: Beriman kepada qadar menjadikan kita sabar ketika gagal dan rendah diri ketika berjaya — bukan malas.

prompt.en: Belief in qada' and qadar is which pillar of iman?
prompt.bm: Beriman kepada qada' dan qadar ialah rukun iman yang ke…

explanation.en: It is the last of the six pillars of iman.
explanation.bm: Ia rukun terakhir daripada enam rukun iman.

prompt.en: Trusting Allah after making full effort is called ______.
prompt.bm: Berserah kepada Allah selepas berusaha sepenuhnya dipanggil ______.

explanation.en: Tawakal comes after ikhtiar, not instead of it.
explanation.bm: Tawakal datang selepas ikhtiar, bukan menggantikannya.

prompt.en: Which attitude reflects correct belief in qadar after failing?
prompt.bm: Sikap manakah mencerminkan kepercayaan yang betul kepada qadar selepas gagal?

explanation.en: A believer accepts with patience and continues to strive.
explanation.bm: Orang beriman menerima dengan sabar dan terus berusaha.

prompt.en: Associating partners with Allah is called…
prompt.bm: Menyekutukan Allah dipanggil…

explanation.en: Syirik is the greatest sin (an-Nisa': 48).
explanation.bm: Syirik dosa paling besar (an-Nisa': 48).

prompt.en: Believing that a black cat crossing your path brings bad luck is an example of…
prompt.bm: Mempercayai kucing hitam melintas membawa sial ialah contoh…

explanation.en: Only Allah determines good and bad; such beliefs are superstition.
explanation.bm: Hanya Allah menentukan baik dan buruk; kepercayaan seperti itu khurafat.

prompt.en: Doing good deeds to be praised by people is called ______.
prompt.bm: Melakukan amalan untuk dipuji orang dipanggil ______.

explanation.en: Riak is hidden syirik (syirik khafi).
explanation.bm: Riak ialah syirik tersembunyi (syirik khafi).

prompt.en: The life between death and the Day of Resurrection is called…
prompt.bm: Alam antara kematian dan hari kebangkitan dipanggil…

explanation.en: Barzakh is the life of the grave.
explanation.bm: Barzakh ialah alam kubur.

prompt.en: The scale that weighs deeds on the Day of Judgement is called…
prompt.bm: Neraca yang menimbang amalan pada hari pembalasan dipanggil…

explanation.en: Mizan weighs good and bad deeds.
explanation.bm: Mizan menimbang amalan baik dan buruk.

prompt.en: Arrange these events of the Hereafter in order.
prompt.bm: Susun peristiwa alam akhirat ini mengikut urutan.

explanation.en: Barzakh → Ba'th → Mahsyar → Hisab & Mizan → Sirat → Paradise or Hell.
explanation.bm: Barzakh → Ba'th → Mahsyar → Hisab & Mizan → Sirat → Syurga atau Neraka.

prompt.en: Match each term with its meaning.
prompt.bm: Padankan istilah dengan maksudnya.

explanation.en: All damage aqidah; open syirik takes a person out of Islam.
explanation.bm: Semua merosakkan akidah; syirik jali mengeluarkan seseorang daripada Islam.

right.en: Using help of jinn/devils to harm

prompt.en: Select ALL practices that damage aqidah.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA amalan yang merosakkan akidah.

explanation.en: Praying (doa) to Allah is worship, not a threat to aqidah.
explanation.bm: Berdoa kepada Allah ialah ibadah, bukan ancaman kepada akidah.

options.en: Believing a charm (tangkal) protects you by itself
Consulting a fortune-teller about the future
options.bm: Bertanya tukang tilik tentang masa depan

options.en: Praying for success before an exam

prompt.en: Which statement is TRUE about qadar?
prompt.bm: Pernyataan manakah BENAR tentang qadar?

explanation.en: Effort is one of the means Allah has decreed.
explanation.bm: Usaha ialah salah satu sebab yang ditetapkan Allah.

options.en: We do not know our qadar, so we must make effort
options.bm: Kita tidak mengetahui takdir kita, jadi kita mesti berusaha

options.en: Qadar only applies to good things

prompt.en: Which is a wisdom (hikmah) of believing in qada' and qadar?
prompt.bm: Apakah hikmah beriman kepada qada' dan qadar?

explanation.en: Success is from Allah (humility); tests are from Allah (patience).
explanation.bm: Kejayaan daripada Allah (rendah diri); ujian daripada Allah (sabar).

options.en: It prevents arrogance when successful and despair when tested
options.bm: Mengelak sombong ketika berjaya dan putus asa ketika diuji

prompt.en: The bridge over Hell that everyone must cross is…
prompt.bm: Titian di atas neraka yang mesti dilalui semua orang ialah…

explanation.en: People cross it at speeds according to their deeds.
explanation.bm: Manusia melintasinya dengan kelajuan mengikut amalan masing-masing.

prompt.en: Signs of the Hour that are small and occur before it (e.g. widespread ignorance) are called…
prompt.bm: Tanda-tanda kiamat yang kecil dan berlaku lebih awal (cth. kejahilan berleluasa) dipanggil…

explanation.en: Major signs include the sun rising from the west.
explanation.bm: Tanda besar termasuk matahari terbit dari barat.

prompt.en: Why is syirik the greatest sin?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah syirik dosa paling besar?

explanation.en: An-Nisa': 48 — Allah does not forgive syirik but forgives other sins for whom He wills.
explanation.bm: An-Nisa': 48 — Allah tidak mengampunkan syirik tetapi mengampunkan dosa lain bagi sesiapa yang dikehendaki-Nya.

options.en: It denies Allah's oneness, the core of Islam, and is not forgiven if one dies upon it
options.bm: Ia menafikan keesaan Allah, teras Islam, dan tidak diampunkan jika mati dalamnya

options.en: It is only a small mistake

prompt.en: Two students both studied hard; one passed and one failed. What does a correct understanding of qadar suggest?
prompt.bm: Dua pelajar sama-sama belajar bersungguh-sungguh; seorang lulus dan seorang gagal. Apakah yang dicadangkan pemahaman qadar yang betul?

explanation.en: Both have reward for effort; outcomes test gratitude and patience.
explanation.bm: Kedua-duanya mendapat pahala usaha; keputusan menguji syukur dan sabar.

options.en: Both did their duty; the one who passed should be grateful, the other patient and keep improving
options.bm: Kedua-duanya telah menunaikan kewajipan; yang lulus bersyukur, yang gagal bersabar dan terus memperbaiki diri

options.en: The one who failed is cursed
The one who passed is better in Allah's sight
options.bm: Yang lulus lebih mulia di sisi Allah

prompt.en: A social media post claims a "lucky stone" brings exam success. What is the BEST response?
prompt.bm: Satu hantaran media sosial mendakwa "batu bertuah" membawa kejayaan peperiksaan. Apakah respons TERBAIK?

explanation.en: Relying on objects for benefit risks syirik.
explanation.bm: Bergantung kepada objek untuk manfaat berisiko syirik.

options.en: Reject it as khurafat; success comes from Allah through effort and doa
options.bm: Menolaknya sebagai khurafat; kejayaan datang daripada Allah melalui usaha dan doa

prompt.en: How should belief in the Last Day affect how you use your phone?
prompt.bm: Bagaimanakah beriman kepada hari akhirat mempengaruhi cara anda menggunakan telefon?

explanation.en: Deeds are written by Raqib and Atid and weighed on the Mizan.
explanation.bm: Amalan dicatat oleh Raqib dan Atid dan ditimbang di Mizan.

options.en: Knowing every action is recorded and will be judged makes you careful about what you watch and post
options.bm: Mengetahui setiap perbuatan dicatat dan akan dihisab menjadikan anda berhati-hati tentang apa yang ditonton dan dihantar

prompt.en: Why is riak called "hidden" syirik?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah riak dipanggil syirik "tersembunyi"?

explanation.en: Guard intentions: do deeds sincerely for Allah (ikhlas).
explanation.bm: Jaga niat: lakukan amalan ikhlas kerana Allah.

options.en: It is in the heart and others may not notice, yet it spoils the reward
options.bm: Ia dalam hati dan orang lain mungkin tidak sedar, namun ia merosakkan pahala
Ia hanya berlaku pada waktu malam
